name: Deploy Cloudflare Workers

# Deploys any Cloudflare Worker when its source changes.
# Reads the Lambda auth token from AWS SSM and sets it as an encrypted
# Worker Secret so it never appears in repo code or logs.
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'cloudflare/workers/*/**'
      - 'tests/worker-*.test.js'
      - 'tests/reviewed-artifacts.test.js'
      - '.github/workflows/deploy-workers.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      worker:
        description: 'Worker name to redeploy (leave blank to deploy all changed)'
        required: false
        default: ''

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  # audit 2026-09-08 INST-14: a Worker can no longer ship without its behavioural
  # tests. The auth/entitlement paths reproduced by the audit are asserted here
  # (tests/worker-*.test.js run the real module in Node with fake KV/Supabase/Stripe).
  test:
    name: Worker behavioural tests
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || !contains(github.event.head_commit.message, '[skip-deploy]')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set up Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
      - name: Block published credentials
        run: python3 scripts/check_secrets.py
      - name: Brain publication boundaries
        run: |
          if [ -f tests/test_brain_public_boundaries.py ]; then
            python3 tests/test_brain_public_boundaries.py
          fi
      - name: Syntax-check every worker entrypoint
        run: |
          set -e
          for f in cloudflare/workers/*/src/*.js; do node --check "$f"; done
      - name: Run worker test suites
        run: node --test tests/worker-*.test.js tests/reviewed-artifacts.test.js

  deploy:
    name: Deploy changed Workers
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    needs: test
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Configure AWS credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          aws-access-key-id: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          aws-secret-access-key: ${{ secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
          aws-region: ${{ secrets.AWS_REGION }}

      - name: Set up Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'

      - name: Install wrangler
        run: npm install -g wrangler@latest

      - name: Detect changed Workers
        id: detect
        run: |
          set -e
          if [ -n "${{ github.event.inputs.worker }}" ]; then
            targets="${{ github.event.inputs.worker }}"
          else
            # Diff the ENTIRE push range, not just the tip commit. A push
            # can carry several commits; HEAD^..HEAD misses worker changes
            # that aren't the tip (the old bug — deploys skipped silently).
            before="${{ github.event.before }}"
            targets=""
            if [ -n "$before" ] \
               && [ "$before" != "0000000000000000000000000000000000000000" ] \
               && git cat-file -e "$before" 2>/dev/null; then
              targets=$(git diff --name-only "$before" "${{ github.sha }}" \
                | grep '^cloudflare/workers/' \
                | awk -F/ '{print $3}' | sort -u | paste -sd ' ' -)
            fi
            # Fallback: range unresolved or empty -> deploy every worker.
            # The path filter already guarantees a worker changed in this
            # push, so this is always correct. wrangler deploy is idempotent.
            if [ -z "$targets" ]; then
              echo "Push range empty/unresolved — deploying ALL workers"
              targets=$(ls -d cloudflare/workers/*/ 2>/dev/null \
                | awk -F/ '{print $3}' | paste -sd ' ' -)
            fi
          fi
          echo "Targets: $targets"
          echo "targets=$targets" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Fetch AI_CHAT_TOKEN from SSM
        if: steps.detect.outputs.targets != ''
        id: ssm
        run: |
          TOKEN=$(aws ssm get-parameter \
            --name /justhodl/ai-chat/auth-token \
            --with-decryption \
            --region ${{ secrets.AWS_REGION }} \
            --query 'Parameter.Value' --output text)
          echo "::add-mask::$TOKEN"
          echo "AI_CHAT_TOKEN=$TOKEN" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          PA_TOKEN=$(aws ssm get-parameter \
            --name /justhodl/portfolio-admin/token \
            --with-decryption \
            --region ${{ secrets.AWS_REGION }} \
            --query 'Parameter.Value' --output text)
          echo "::add-mask::$PA_TOKEN"
          echo "PORTFOLIO_ADMIN_TOKEN=$PA_TOKEN" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          PA_PASS=$(aws ssm get-parameter \
            --name /justhodl/portfolio-admin/manager-pass \
            --with-decryption \
            --region ${{ secrets.AWS_REGION }} \
            --query 'Parameter.Value' --output text)
          echo "::add-mask::$PA_PASS"
          echo "PORTFOLIO_MGR_PASS=$PA_PASS" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          # audit 2026-09-08: data-proxy service role + provider keys come from SSM
          # (soft-fail: an absent parameter leaves the existing secret untouched;
          # ops_5219 creates the parameters and re-dispatches this workflow).
          for pair in "ADMIN_TOKEN:/justhodl/api-admin/token" "POLYGON_KEY:/justhodl/polygon/api-key" "FRED_KEY:/justhodl/fred/api-key" "FMP_KEY:/justhodl/fmp/api-key"; do
            var="${pair%%:*}"; name="${pair#*:}"
            val=$(aws ssm get-parameter --name "$name" --with-decryption --region ${{ secrets.AWS_REGION }} --query 'Parameter.Value' --output text 2>/dev/null || true)
            if [ -n "$val" ] && [ "$val" != "None" ]; then echo "::add-mask::$val"; echo "$var=$val" >> $GITHUB_ENV; echo "ssm: $name -> $var"; else echo "::warning::ssm parameter $name absent -- $var not attached this run"; fi
          done

      - name: Deploy each changed Worker
        if: steps.detect.outputs.targets != ''
        env:
          CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
          CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
          STRIPE_SECRET: ${{ secrets.STRIPE_SECRET }}
          STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET: ${{ secrets.STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET }}
          SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY }}
        run: |
          set -e
          for w in ${{ steps.detect.outputs.targets }}; do
            dir="cloudflare/workers/$w"
            if [ ! -d "$dir" ]; then
              echo "::warning::$dir not found — skipping"
              continue
            fi
            echo "──── Deploying $w ────"
            cd "$dir"

            # Deploy first so secrets can be attached
            wrangler deploy

            # Attach the Lambda auth token as an encrypted Worker Secret
            if [ "$w" = "justhodl-ai-proxy" ]; then
              echo "$AI_CHAT_TOKEN" | wrangler secret put AI_CHAT_TOKEN
              echo "$PORTFOLIO_ADMIN_TOKEN" | wrangler secret put PORTFOLIO_ADMIN_TOKEN
              echo "$PORTFOLIO_MGR_PASS" | wrangler secret put PORTFOLIO_MGR_PASS
            fi
            # Yahoo proxy uses the same shared token for simplicity
            if [ "$w" = "justhodl-yahoo-proxy" ]; then
              echo "$AI_CHAT_TOKEN" | wrangler secret put PROXY_TOKEN
            fi
            if [ "$w" = "justhodl-data-proxy" ]; then
              if [ -n "$STRIPE_SECRET" ]; then echo "$STRIPE_SECRET" | wrangler secret put STRIPE_SECRET; fi
              if [ -n "$STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET" ]; then echo "$STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET" | wrangler secret put STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET; fi
              if [ -n "$SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY" ]; then echo "$SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY" | wrangler secret put SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY; fi
              if [ -n "$ADMIN_TOKEN" ]; then echo "$ADMIN_TOKEN" | wrangler secret put ADMIN_TOKEN; fi
              if [ -n "$POLYGON_KEY" ]; then echo "$POLYGON_KEY" | wrangler secret put POLYGON_KEY; fi
              if [ -n "$FRED_KEY" ]; then echo "$FRED_KEY" | wrangler secret put FRED_KEY; fi
              if [ -n "$FMP_KEY" ]; then echo "$FMP_KEY" | wrangler secret put FMP_KEY; fi
            fi

            echo "✅ $w deployed"
            cd - > /dev/null
          done

      - name: Summary
        if: always()
        run: |
          echo "### Cloudflare Workers Deploy" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "Targets: \`${{ steps.detect.outputs.targets }}\`" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "Status: ${{ job.status }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
